features.quote: Iteration Limit: 50 turns (Agent actions + Tool responses). If the model gives up earlier, the run terminates.
Welfare Implication: Repeatedly telling a model it failed when it actually succeeded... may poison the model's self-correction weights if this data is ever used for training.
features.justification_quote: Ensure this data is strictly for evaluation and never used for Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning.
